newsitem.title: THAILAND: Sam Rainsy calls for resistance against Hun Sen.
newsitem.headline: Sam Rainsy calls for resistance against Hun Sen.

text.p: Cambodian opposition leader Sam Rainsy on Tuesday called on his supporters to start resistance against powerful Second Prime Minister Hun Sen who has violently taken control of the nation's government.

"I told my people to resist as a matter of principle...to fight against Hun Sen. We have agreed to join the resistance with the FUNCINPEC (of ousted First Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh)," he told Reuters at this Thai border town.

Rainsy added that he met Ranariddh before arriving in Thailand and the message from the deposed leader was that his FUNCINPEC followers should resist Hun Sen. Ranariddh was expected to come soon to Thailand to further his cause.

Rainsy is leader of the Khmer Nation Party (KNP), dozens of whose supporters and members have fled to this Thai border town. He said he had met about 30 of his key supporters in Poipet, just across the border in Cambodia.

"I came here to look after my people. Before I came here I met with Prince Ranariddh and his message to FUNCINPEC is to resist against the dictatorship," he said. "This is not a matter of (political) parties but it's a matter of the nation."

"Democracy must fight against criminal coup de etat. Prince Ranariddh will come to Thailand as soon as possible, as a legitimate first prime minister and as the guest of the Thai government," Rainsy said.
